notablePrerequisites:
Light of Promise attached to Sage of Hours.
Celestial Mantle attached to a creature that can attack this turn and that cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
Your life total is at least 5.
description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Celestial Mantle attached.
Celestial Mantle triggers, doubling your life total.
Sage of Hours triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the life you gained.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
